general.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in Juniper Session Smart Router and Session Smart Conductor, the most severe of which could allow for arbitrary command execution as root. Session Smart Router is Juniper’s software-based SD-WAN router, and Session Smart Conductor is the management and orchestration platform for a fleet of these routers. Successful exploitation of the most severe of these vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-103406) could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the affected Conductor. An attacker with root access could then install programs; view, change, or delete data; or create new accounts with full administrative rights. Because the Conductor manages the router fleet, a compromise could also put every managed site at risk.
general.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Juniper Products Could Allow for Arbitrary Code Execution

general.summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions. It also relates to CVE-2026-132165 aka Fail2Install in that it addresses remaining vulnerable installation states
general.title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
